title: Noor and the Crown
author: Cyrus Blackwood
blurb: Hazel Villalobos, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
